The institutional investor held 44,447 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.60 million, up from 15,397 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lowe Brockenbrough & Company Inc who had been investing in Dominion Energy Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $42.75 billion market cap company. (NYSE:D) has declined 11.17% since April 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.72% the S&P500.
